notes: Kept set covers piRNA biogenesis and transposon silencing (fly, mouse, hamster, planarian, mosquito, locust, moth), RNAi/small-RNA inheritance in C. elegans, KRAB-ZFP control of TEs, animal and plant miRNA biogenesis, miRNAs in developmental timing, stem cells, germline and neurogenesis (let-7, lin-4, miR-124, mir-35), and plant RdDM/AGO siRNA selection, with 4-6 papers per year 2016-2026. It lacks phasiRNA and cross-kingdom RNAi (only plant-to-plant exogenous miRNA), zebrafish miR-430/MZT and mammalian endo-siRNA papers; the 2023-2026 picks are low-cited and three (miR-137 microglia, miR-71 UPRmt, Myc-regulated miRNAs) are general miRNA biology rather than development, while several equally fitting 2017 and 2019 piRNA papers were cut only to keep the year spread.
